_comment: Optional intro text for each Type, shown beside the section heading. Keys must match the Type column in the sheet. Types not listed here still appear, just without a description. Order here also sets section order on the home page (unlisted types follow, largest first).
Longform: Ambitious, visually rich long reads that combine reporting, photography, video and bespoke graphics into immersive storytelling.
Atom: Standalone interactive experiences, from quizzes and calculators to explorable guides and scrollytelling, built to put readers at the centre of the story.
Storycard: Tappable, card-based stories that break big subjects into bite-sized, highly visual moments.
Calculator: Personalised tools that turn data into answers about readers' own money, health and lives.
Quiz: Playful tests of knowledge and opinion that invite readers to take part.
Gallery: Picture-led storytelling that brings major moments to life through photography and video.
